title: When attachment keeps tightening the grip as a steady practice
issueStatement: The mind keeps clinging to what it cannot finally keep. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru teaches love without possession and steadiness without denial. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: Freedom is not numbness. It is steadiness before what usually hooks the mind. Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it.
actionPrompt: Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it. Repeat what you can actually keep.
